This script merges gzipped STAR ReadsPerGene.out.tab.gz files and annotates each row with gene symbols from the Gencode v39 GTF.

### Load required packages

```{r load packages}
library(rprojroot)
library(rtracklayer)
library(tools)
```

### Set directory paths

```{r dir paths}
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "human-rna-expression")
input_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "input")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
```

```{r}
# read + merge all STAR count files
# prior to run this script, all START count files need to be downloaded from the S3 bucket
# "rnaseq_star_gene_count" in data_dir should include 53 samples. 

files <- list.files(file.path(input_dir, "rnaseq_star_gene_count"),
                    pattern = "ReadsPerGene\\.out\\.tab\\.gz$",
                    full.names = TRUE)

read_counts <- function(f) {
  df <- read.delim(gzfile(f), header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  sample <- sub("\\_20250506\\.ReadsPerGene\\.out\\.tab\\.gz$", "", basename(f))
  setNames(df[,c("V1","V2")], c("gene_id", sample))
}
lst <- lapply(files, read_counts)
merged <- Reduce(function(x,y) merge(x,y,by="gene_id",all=TRUE), lst)
merged[is.na(merged)] <- 0
```

```{r}
# remove the last 4 rows (STAR’s summary lines)
merged <- merged[1:(nrow(merged) - 4), ]
```

```{r}
# import GTF and build ID→symbol map
gtf   <- import(file.path(data_dir, "gencode.v39.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf.gz"), format = "gtf")
genes <- gtf[gtf$type == "gene", ]
map   <- unique(data.frame(
  gene_id   = mcols(genes)$gene_id,
  gene_name = mcols(genes)$gene_name,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
))
```

```{r}
# join on versioned gene_id
annotated <- merge(map,
                   merged,
                   by = "gene_id",
                   all.y = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Load manifest and build rename map
# adjust the path & separator to your manifest’s format
manifest <- read.delim(file.path(input_dir, "Haydar-RNAseq-manifest_IDs_assigned.tsv"),
                       header = TRUE,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# build a named vector: names = Bioassay_ID, values = external_sample_id
id_map <- setNames(manifest$external_sample_id,
                   manifest$Bioassay_ID)
```

```{r}
# the object ‘annotated’ has columns: gene_id, gene_name, BA_0GVSQNSM, BA_1ABCDEF, …
old_cols <- colnames(annotated)
```

```{r}
# for every column that matches a Bioassay_ID in the map, replace with external ID
new_cols <- ifelse(old_cols %in% names(id_map),
                   id_map[old_cols],
                   old_cols)

colnames(annotated) <- new_cols
```

```{r}
write.table(annotated,
            file      = file.path(results_dir, "merged-RNA-rawcounts-annotated.tsv"),
            sep       = "\t",
            quote     = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = TRUE)
```
